razonamiento: The architecture diagram shows an event collection and security rules evaluation pipeline centered around Amazon Neptune. Drawn boxes and narration mentions were merged: the sharder service (b6) feeds the collect Kinesis Data Stream (b0), which streams into Amazon Neptune (b2) and forwards to the rules Kinesis Data Stream (b1). Rules evaluations write violations to DynamoDB (b4) and query Neptune. Neptune connects to backing stores DynamoDB and Elasticsearch (OpenSearch, b3), sends metrics to CloudWatch (b5), and sends alerts to Slack (b8). The drawn envelope icon (b7) corresponds to email notifications (SES) mentioned in narration; since no line connects to it, it is kept as an isolated node without inventing edges.
nombre: Cloud Security Posture Evaluation Architecture with Neptune
